name: Stellar Bloom gathers four random herb tokens
notes: Stellar Bloom is an ASTRA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ASTRA champion (Arisanna, Astral Zenith) to unlock element access. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid; the ability's own four Gather() calls resolve immediately after the last reserve payment with no opportunity-window PASS or player decision needed, each summoning a herb token chosen via the engine's deterministic RNG (seed 42). Only the base Gather-four effect is covered; the [Class Bonus] Starcalling (2) alternate-timing clause is out of scope.
